name: @playliquid/platform-identity
description: PlayLiquid GameOS player/tenant identity read-model service (PL-015). Identity records, alias/display naming with per-tenant uniqueness, tenant scoping (R20, negatively tested) and append-only profile versioning (E10) over @playliquid/platform-contracts primitives and tenancy oracles. No authentication protocols (SSO/OAuth) — product integration, not this package. Pure domain: the service instance is the single mutable-state owner; persistence and time live behind ports with in-memory fakes; no IO, no timers, no globals.
